senses.definition: n.pr.gent.coll. steppe-dwellers of N. Arabia (WetzstZvölkerpsych. vii. 463 f.; extended later (so Herod. ii.11 etc.) to whole peninsula, cf. Arabic العَرَبُ the Arabs, Bedúwy the people, DoughtyArab. Deserta, i. 224; Sab. ערבן, ערב, אערב CIS iv. p. 123, Assyrian Aribu, Arubu, Arabi, people in N. Arabia, DlPa 295 f. 304 f. COT Je 25:24; also Urbi DlPa 305 f. of nomad ‘Arab’ tribes);—מַלְכֵי ע׳ הַשּׁסֹכְנִים בַּמִּדְבָּר Je 25:24 (v. i. עֵרֶב), 2 Ch 9:14 + ‖ 1 K 10:15 (v. id.); ע׳ also Ez 27:21 + 30:5 (v. id.); v. especially NöArabia in Ency. Bib.
